title: Selects for a documentary paper edit (written by Claude or the editor, built by paper_edit.py). Quotes come from bite ids in bites.json, never typed text.

target_minutes.description: planned running time of the finished film

purpose.description: what this section does in the film

items.description: one row: a bite (by id, optionally with the picture over it), a moment without words (picture + sound description), or a gap (what is still missing, as a question)

picture.description: what we see (the filmmaker's footage or a question)

note.description: why this bite is here; shown small under it

sound.description: only on rows without a bite: ambience, music, silence

gap.description: what is missing, as a question
